title: Inbox order
question: Which items show first in the inbox?
impacts: New work shows at once; old items wait.
Matches the design; nothing waits forever.

title: Dock badge
question: Does the Dock badge count to-dos?

text:
Log in to the **staging** server, then run `pnpm e2e` in `apps/desktop`.

If it fails, run `pnpm e2e` again with:

```sh
CONTR_E2E=1 pnpm e2e --repeat-each 3
```
The CI cache is now keyed on the lockfile.
